imgmerge.drop: Drop photos here or click to choose them (several — they join in the order you add them)
imgmerge.opt.v: Vertically — chats and long page captures
imgmerge.opt.none: Leave them as they are — edges may step
imgmerge.status.idle: Photos stay in your browser — nothing is uploaded anywhere.
imgmerge.err.tooBig: The output would be too large. Try “match the smallest”.
imgmerge.err.render: Could not turn it into an image.
imgmerge.file.name: stitched.png
imgmerge.say.picked: {n} photos · they join in the order you added them.
